Research only, already-seen2024-2025, no2026 records/acquisition/fits/spend. Owner-frozen same-day VWAP look-ahead, equity31-day one-lot expiry payoff, strike-only mean-preserving grid and all-combinations dual MILP. Three store roots need owner confirmation. Eight explicitly declared one-factor comparison arms use existing foreach; tickers are not fanned into a chosen subset. Numeric PLACEHOLDERs and unresolved source profiles fail closed. Node names refer to pipeline or foreach.pipeline.

G2 derives/onboards nine seed11 evaluation rows with fit/checkpoint/source hashes, all-label information cutoff INCLUDING monitoring/early stopping and availability, and archived forecast-valid interval. Never infer from training cutoff alone. Replace table-file with the existing registered-source read seam only after verification. Zero date/hash/path remain fail-closed.

stock_bars.notes: PROPOSED multi-file onboarded parquet reader; inventory reuse before building. DateBoundedParquet protects reads before materialization. G1 source profile must pin a common adjustment vintage and allowed split inventory that reconstruct as-traded prices without2026; unknown basis refuses. Schema and full-vs-incremental snapshot semantics must be verified, never infer them from source names.

as_traded.notes: EXISTS; input profile must prove later split ratios present in this bounded source explain its adjustment vintage. A 2026-adjusted close cannot be repaired by silently dropping2026 splits. Reject unresolved basis before this transform. Irregular and unsupported holding-period actions are excluded downstream; unknown action histories remain labeled assumptions. Pin irregular_tolerance to the existing feature workflow.

option_chain.notes: PROPOSED. Protected intake selects metadata-proven pre2026 members/partitions BEFORE parsing/dedup; filtering ObservationStreamRows output is NOT sufficient. Missing trusted member bounds or mixed JSON members refuse rather than scan2026. Preserve dedup/fingerprints across per-source roots. Only then apply exact DTE and named phase windows and field mapping. G1 verifies registrations/fields/standard deliverables and safe metadata census; quote and expiry both before2026. No provider acquisition.

model_inputs.notes: Existing ParquetRows, not a new feature builder. G2 replaces the placeholder projection from the verified archived42-feature/scale contract and pins the source snapshot/hash to the inference package. No guesses or all-column imputation. Both date bounds apply before materialization; forward labels are not passed as model features. Missing or incompatible profile refuses. This source already exists; no acquisition of new market data.

forecasts.notes: PROPOSED inference wrapper. Use verified42-feature rows, exact order, scale and ticker encoding, archived training medians for admitted missing values, then loaded scaler/mask exactly once. G2 pins snapshots/schema/preprocessing and parity against saved forecasts. Schedule cutoff includes monitoring and other fitted selection labels, plus availability; require origin within archived forecast-valid interval. No compatible checkpoint/feature/head/profile -> explicit skip. Seed and estimator must match loaded state. As-traded spot has G1 verified strike basis. Own-date forecast uses own-date data and retains look-ahead fill label.

masses.notes: PROPOSED mean-preserving strike projection; grid all chain strikes before liquidity, tails at extremes. Report Delta in spot units, CDF deviations and nominal payoff-integral discrepancy; mesh limits unresolved -> refuse. Continuous F-ball containment is NOT claimed for a discrete ball. Delta policy stays G3. Emit masses and a JSON evidence dict with all date-level mesh/refusal records for RunReport; forward forecast skips.

rho_calibration.notes: PROPOSED child audit adapter over shared generic bootstrap/grid owners; tier decision remains G3. Expected-loss candidate uses realized MINUS robust loss; upper mean bound <=0. Template evidence covers only that fixed population, not all MILP-selected trades. Match shorts to nearest same-type nominal price-quantile strike (distance tie lower), longs wing_strikes distinct same-type positions outward; require liquidity, standard contract and strict ordering, otherwise missing-template refusal. Payoff-only audit never uses completed-window pricing tiers. Calendar blocks: complete [start,start+B) date groups, start+B <= last_observed+1 day; uniform complete-start sampling with replacement, concatenate until n dates and truncate; no calendar wrap. Refuse insufficient min_dates/no complete blocks, report effective/degenerate support. Primary selection only; longer sensitivity reported. Legacy observed-count behavior stays unchanged. Grid/search/selection/phase choice, Delta and weights remain G3. Calibration-only history gives constant rho; entry outcomes are excluded unless owner admits them. Every used outcome is published strictly before monthly reference. Emit rho and JSON audit dict (bounds/residuals/blocks/counts/all refusals), consumed by diagnostics. No test-profit selection.

params.fee_status: PROVISIONAL placeholder until the owner supplies the real figure

select.notes: PROPOSED PyomoSolve child subclass with explicit non-capital role. One all-ordered-strike dual MILP per ticker-date per declared arm. Resolve only the named arm override from the existing sweep list; base settings otherwise. No product/automatic expansion. rho_base uses calibrated rho; nominal uses0 even if calibration unsupported, as a labeled research comparator; calibrated arms with null rho no-trade. Validate same frozen candidate/contract policy and G1 action basis; known holding-window split/recap/nonstandard/irregular deliverables refuse, unknown action history stays an assumption. Per-contract prices separate puts/calls, haircut as configured and fee once per leg. Negative/missing/nonfinite premium or negative sell proceeds refuse that contract. Tiers estimated from completed calibration-window median trade_count are frozen for ENTRY pricing only. Primary maximize then second solve minimize z within certified dollar tolerance; report bounds/gaps and skip uncertified solves. Band support deferred; validate nonempty nominal-containing set if admitted. Emit decisions/selections/solves/skips with arm_id, unique decision_id and actual contracts, plus JSON evidence including per-ticker/arm counts and refusals.

settle.notes: PROPOSED child expiry payoff accounting. Emit entry orders/fills plus opposite-side synthetic expiry closing orders/fills for EACH leg at its intrinsic value, zero expiry fee. No intrinsic external cashflow and no unclosed lots. Each position_id encodes arm_id/decision_id/actual contract; preserve contract mapping so overlap never nets across decisions. Both fill kinds carry fill_label; expiry label includes labels.exercise. Existing shared bounded settlement-close rule reused, later confirming bar must itself be pre2026. Each decision ends flat and sum leg P&L equals outcome = multiplier*(credit-intrinsic)-entry fees. One condor outcome, not four independent trades. Emits orders/fills/outcomes/skips plus JSON evidence with actual-contract mapping, per-decision reconciliation, arm/ticker results and all failures. No portfolio-return claim.

events.notes: EXISTS RowsToEvents; one isolated arm log. Orders/fills map decision-scoped position_id, not shared actual contract; actual contracts retained in settle evidence. Fill tags carry entry look-ahead and expiry assignment-ignored labels. No external cashflow for intrinsic payoff. IDs include arm to avoid collisions. Outcome and per-decision reconciliation retained; report counts condor outcomes separately from leg trips. Run verdict UNJUDGED, no performance qualification.

report.notes: EXISTS EvaluationReport, isolated arm events and arm directory. Only summary/provenance initially, avoiding portfolio or four-leg-trip claims; detailed condor outcomes, mesh/calibration and per-ticker sensitivity evidence are in diagnostics. No combining arms into one event log.

diagnostics.notes: EXISTS RunReport. Stage labels in supplied evidence identify mesh, calibration, selection and settlement. Full JSON evidence (including every date/ticker/refusal) and Markdown saved through node-scoped artifact writer, one diagnostics node per arm. Report no portfolio return; retain one condor per decision and exact end-flat accounting. Shared calibration is unchanged across comparison arms.

foreach.notes: Eight explicit one-factor arms, base settings except the declared index override. No Cartesian product, no ticker fan-out, no model fits. Node references and $each expand through existing foreach; each report directory is its arm key, diagnostic artifacts are node-scoped.
